inventory_summary: Inventoried 32 footings (20 FT-B/FT-GF strips, 5 court strips), 6 pads, 35 FoundationWalls, 22 slabs/bands, 40 rebar sets (walls, footings, 11 piers, SL-M-DECK), 10 north-entry/garden pier shafts, and the AB Stones SRW. Measured from the resolved model (pickle probes in scratchpad) and read all assigned sheets (S-001, S-100, A-501, A-509, A-585..A-591). Web-checked ICF-6 (Fox/Nudura) and AB Stones. Checks.json foundation findings read; frost_depth check body read (finding 2). NOT examined: IFC/print3d emitters, ConcreteSpec mix chemistry beyond cover, calc-package arithmetic for engineered retaining walls (capacity out of scope), A-509 pier/pad geometry beyond a visual read (no discrepancy seen), MASAZ embedment vs ICF core against the ESR, rebar bar-bend schedules.
verified_clean: FT-B-*/FT-GF-*/FT-SG-*/PD-BW-*: bottoms -117.44" / -84" / -121.44" / -119.44"|-88" against grade -34" (SITE_GRADE) = 83"/50"/87" (court by NFS section 54" below the floor)/85"/54"; all >= 42"; S-100 elevations -9.79'/-7.00'/-10.12'/-9.95'/-7.33' match.

Basement walls: 96.00" pour (z -109.44..-13.44) on 8" footings; top -13 7/16" bearing seat matches S-100 T.O.W -1.12'; studs 0.5-6.0" sit wholly on the 8/12/12" concrete (5.5" of 5.5" bearing) on every W-B-* x W-M-* pair.
Garage ICF stem: 64.00" = 4 x 16" courses, top -12" = 22" above grade, bottom 42" below (S-100 -1.00'/-6.33' match); footing 20" x 8" crushed stone centred on the 11.9" section (toes 4.3/4.7").
Wall lengths vs S-100 FOUNDATION WALL SCHEDULE: 92/36/22/80/68/7/18/21/51 LF all recompute from model axes; footing/pad schedule sizes and quantities (F1-F4, P1-P3) match.

Rebar vs S-100 R1-R10 and rebar_layout_basis.md: FT-SG-S 25/19 #5 + 7 #5 bars, W-SG-S #5@7" x32 + #4@16", garage #4@16", basement #5@41" (d=6.44" from the soil face >= 5.75" for an 8" wall), three #4 rows at 6"/48"/90".

Cover by face: court footings 3.0" all faces; court stems 3.0" exterior; piers 2.3"/pad dowel 3.3" from bottom; deck cap top bars 0.75"; garage core 1.5" (EPS-formed) - ACI 20.5.1.3.1 consistent; dowel embedment 9.0" (24" into court walls) vs ldh 7.11" #5.

Rebar laps/hooks: basement #4 wall laps 30" (R608.5.4(1)); hand tables (ld 33.9/37.9 db, ldh 7.115" #5 at 5,000 psi) re-derived and correct; all bars galvanized A767 except interior SL-M-DECK (black).

Slabs: SL-B-FLOOR 3.5" on 2" XPS + 4" stone, top = footing top (deliberate, decision #107, clipped area 1,062 SF vs S-100 1,064); SL-G-FLOOR 3.5" at grade -34" on 1" XPS + 4" stone; stone base courses extend past footing bottoms by design.
AB Stones SRW (W-RG-*): 8" coursing, 12" depth, 48" = 6 courses with 8" embedment; matches Allan Block 8x12x18 (allanblock.com).
Sill anchorage: MASAZ at 4'-0" o.c. (<= 6'-0"), code.R403_1_6 passes; no CMU anywhere in the house (no 7-5/8" coursing to check).

findings.title: Garage wood sill overhangs the ICF concrete core by 1-7/8"; only 3-5/8" of the 5-1/2" sill bears on concrete (note claims 4-1/2")

evidence.measured: Along the wall normal (exterior = 0): W-GF-* concrete core spans t=2.5"..8.5"; W-G-* stud/sill layer spans 0.625"..6.125" (5.5"). Overlap = 3.625"; 1.875" of the 5.5" sill sits over exterior EPS (and the sheathing line). Same on W, E, S, N.
evidence.expected: Note says the 6" core keeps 4-1/2" of the 5-1/2" PT sill bearing on concrete (1" overhang); a sill over EPS is unsupported (EPS is not a bearing material). With manufacturer 2-5/8" EPS the bearing would drop to 3-1/2".
evidence.method: Load model (load_plan+resolve, pickled to /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-colincatlin-Documents-NoCloud-TypeHaus/a9292deb-6aa8-41a7-a63e-497e3c7970b9/scratchpad/geometry-review/F5/m.pkl); for each W-GF-x / W-G-x pair take layer polygons, project onto the wall's left normal (axis start, unit normal), compare 'concrete' span with 'stud' span (probe $SC/p9.py style). Sheet A-591 (page 126) draws the sill half over the foam.

findings.source: notes/garage_wall_detail_side.md:92 (4-1/2" claim); IRC R403.1.6 / R404.1.4 ICF stem bearing; 11" ICF section = 6" core + 2x2.5" EPS
findings.proposed_fix: Either offset the framed wall inboard so the sill lands fully on the core (but that breaks the declared sheathing/EPS coplanar face), or accept and detail a bearing strip/ledge or a narrower sill; at minimum correct the note and have the ICF supplier confirm sill bearing over foam. Needs owner decision.

findings.title: Frost protection of FT-B-S1..S4 is credited to XPS wings that do not run along them; check treats any wing within 42" as shielding

evidence.measured: Footings FT-B-S1..S4 bear 8" below the court floor (bottom -117.44", floor -109.44"). Wings: W x150..190" y-50..-10 (2" XPS, 40" long), E x242..282", N x190..242" y-34..-10 (1"). Footings span x0..432", outboard edge y=-4". Wing starts at y=-10 (6" gap from footing edge, 4.06" of that is foam); no wing lies along S1 (x0..118) or S4 (x314..432) - nearest is 32" away - yet checks.json says S1 'is frost-protected by SL-SG-FROST-W' and S4 by -E.
evidence.expected: R403.3 wings run continuously along the protected footing from the wall (dimensions A along walls, B/C at corners). Wing should adjoin the insulated wall/footing and span the strip it protects.
evidence.method: Load model (load_plan+resolve, pickled to /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-colincatlin-Documents-NoCloud-TypeHaus/a9292deb-6aa8-41a7-a63e-497e3c7970b9/scratchpad/geometry-review/F5/m.pkl); print Polygon(s.outline).bounds for SL-SG-FROST-* and FT-B-S*; read checks.json 'structural.frost_depth' messages for FT-B-S1/S4; checks.py shield test is a pure 42" distance.

findings.source: IRC R403.3 / Table R403.3(1); ASCE 32; checks.py frost_depth
findings.proposed_fix: Engineer to size wings per Table R403.3(1) for the site air-freezing index and run them contiguous along S1..S4 (or deepen/NFS-bed those strips); change the check to require wing contact/overlap along the footing length rather than distance.

findings.title: ICF-6 stem modelled with 2.5" EPS (11" section) on no named product; 6"-core forms from Fox/Nudura are 2-5/8" EPS, 11-1/4" overall

evidence.measured: Stem layers 2.5+6+2.5 = 11.0" (+0.625 gwb, +0.3 coil band = 11.925"); stem height 64" = 4x16" courses; no manufacturer, ESR or block height cited anywhere.
evidence.expected: Fox Blocks 6" straight: form width 11.25", block 16" high x 48" long; Nudura 6": 11-1/4" overall, EPS 2-5/8", block 18" high (72" stem would need 4 courses of 18"). The comment 'this garage's ICF-6 form genuinely has a thinner EPS facing' names no product.
evidence.method: Inspect foundation.py comment block + prices.toml (no ICF block row); WebSearch Fox Blocks / Nudura 6" core dimensions.

findings.proposed_fix: Name the ICF product and cite its section/EPS/course height in source=. If 2-5/8" EPS is used the stem is 11.25" and every coplanar-with-sheathing/sill-bearing number moves 1/4"; if 18" forms are used the 64" stem is not a whole number of courses.

findings.title: A-585..A-591 print one basement-wall note block on every foundation detail: wrong for the 12", curb, interior and ICF-garage sheets; slab line says 3,500 psi on 3" XPS

evidence.measured: Every sheet prints: 'Basement wall: 8" pour, #5 at 41" o.c.'; 'Basement CI: 4" XPS'; 'Slab: 3-1/2" at 3,500 psi on 3" XPS, 10 mil poly, 4" gravel'. A-591 (GARAGE_ICF_6) therefore claims an 8" pour with #5@41" and 4" XPS; A-585/A-590 are 12" walls.
evidence.expected: Model: SL-B-FLOOR is INTERIOR_SLAB_MIX 4,000 psi on 2" XPS (SLAB_FLOOR); SL-G-FLOOR 1" XPS; garage ICF is 6" core #4@16" with 2.5" EPS; 12" walls are horizontals-only (NR) with no #5@41". S-100 schedule itself says 2" XPS.
evidence.method: Read permit_set_full.pdf pages 120-126 right-hand note column; compare plan/assemblies/foundation.py SLAB_FLOOR and mixes.py INTERIOR_SLAB_MIX.

findings.proposed_fix: Make the sheet notes per-assembly (derive wall/slab lines from the sheet's own assemblies) or rewrite the shared note neutrally: 4,000 psi, 2" XPS, 'wall per S-100 schedule'.

findings.title: Footing projection beyond the wall face is 8.03" on FT-B-N1..N4, FT-B-W1/W2 against an 8" thick footing (R403.1.1: P <= T); check tests only the 2" minimum

evidence.expected: P <= T = 8.00" (IRC R403.1.1 as quoted in the check docstring); trivial 0.03" but a literal exceedance - and the check never tests the maximum.

findings.proposed_fix: Move the footing 1/32" inboard (or specify 8-1/2" depth) and add the P<=T leg to bearing_wall_footing.
